subject: storytime
title: Amelia Bedelia words
about: Amelia Bedelia is a new housekeeper who follows every instruction on her chore list exactly as it is written, so the dusting, the curtains and even the dinner end up in a hilarious muddle. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, stopping to talk about what each chore really meant.

book.author: Peggy Parish
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A housekeeper who does precisely what she is told, which is never quite what anyone meant.
